Bringing You Our Best
Mennel is a progressive company with a rich history. Headquartered in Fostoria, Ohio and spanning seven states, The Mennel Milling Company is strategically positioned to deliver flour and corn-based products to our partners throughout the U.S. and around the world. Although we've been around for more than 140 years, we are looking forward to the future.
